correctness.rationale: An exact maximality iff unmatched-independent lemma and complete disjoint-edge recursion prove the 545 maximal matchings with distribution 176,336,33 at sizes 6,7,8. All 176 minima and all possible single-edge substitutions are enumerated. The resulting 96 edges partition into 80 isolated states and six connected 2-regular 16-state graphs, necessarily six 16-cycles. An independent complement/perfect-matching enumeration from the LCF labeling reproduces the result. Both packaged scripts ran and reached VERIFY_OK. The general edge-pivot lemma has a direct contradiction proof.

value.rationale: An exact complete minimum-maximal-matching census and its state-exchange graph on a canonical symmetric cubic graph is a natural edge domination invariant. The split into 80 frozen optimum configurations and six movable 16-cycles is a structural mobility obstruction not implied by the optimum size or matching-complex face vector. It is useful for understanding optimal solution landscape and local pivot algorithms, without asserting larger graph-family conclusions.
